label: Uses the provider the user asked for, otherwise prefers claude, then codex
paraphrase: Honors an explicit provider choice, else falls back from claude to codex
wrongLabel: Picks whichever CLI answered fastest last time
unclearLabel: Uses the provider saved in the extension's settings, otherwise prefers claude
heldOutLabel: Picks the provider named by the docviz pr command's --provider flag

label: Checks whether the claude and codex commands are on PATH
paraphrase: Looks up which of the two CLIs are installed
wrongLabel: Downloads the claude and codex CLIs if they are missing
unclearLabel: Detects which CLIs the helper will use to write cards
heldOutLabel: Checks for the CLIs each time the side panel opens

label: Estimates a Codex call's cost from its tokens, cached input and images
paraphrase: Prices a Codex call as an estimate from its usage
wrongLabel: Reads the exact Codex cost reported by the CLI
unclearLabel: Estimates Codex cost using the rates the user passed on the command line
heldOutLabel: Estimates Codex cost at the prices OpenAI published this month

label: Overrides Codex prices from a comma list, keeping defaults for blank fields
paraphrase: Lets the user set custom Codex prices
wrongLabel: Resets every Codex price to zero when a field is blank
unclearLabel: Applies the prices given with --codex-rates when the helper starts
heldOutLabel: Lets the extension's options page override Codex prices

label: Finds the text between two markers and its line range
paraphrase: Returns a slice of text by start and end markers, with line numbers
wrongLabel: Deletes the lines between two markers from the file
unclearLabel: Finds a PR step's code between the markers the agent wrote in steps.json
heldOutLabel: Finds the code a reviewer clicks through to from the PR comment

label: Adds up several calls' cost and marks the total estimated if any part was
paraphrase: Totals the spend of a list of calls
wrongLabel: Averages several calls' cost and drops the estimated ones
unclearLabel: Totals the cost of a card and its repair call for the PR comment footer
heldOutLabel: Adds up every call made while breaking down one page

label: Makes a random pairing code from letters and digits that are hard to confuse
wrongLabel: Derives the pairing code from the machine's hostname
unclearLabel: Makes the pairing code shown in the terminal on first run
heldOutLabel: Makes a new pairing code each time the helper restarts

label: Reads the saved config and creates a new token when it is missing or a new one is asked for
paraphrase: Loads the config file, generating a token if needed
wrongLabel: Reads the config and exits with an error when the token is missing
unclearLabel: Reads the config from the folder XDG_CONFIG_HOME points to
heldOutLabel: Reads the token the extension pasted in during setup

label: Adds one call's cost to a card, splitting a batch call evenly
paraphrase: Charges a call to a card's running cost breakdown
wrongLabel: Replaces the card's cost with the latest call's cost
unclearLabel: Adds the cost of a Simpler or More detail call to its card
heldOutLabel: Adds a picture's cost to the card it illustrates

label: Refuses more work once today's spend reaches the daily budget
paraphrase: Returns a message blocking new work when the budget is spent
wrongLabel: Raises the daily budget automatically when today's spend reaches it
unclearLabel: Refuses work once spend reaches the budget the user set on the options page
heldOutLabel: Stops a breakdown partway through when the budget runs out

label: Adds a call to today's and the all-time spend, starting fresh on a new day
paraphrase: Records a call's cost in the spend ledger, rolling over at midnight
wrongLabel: Adds a call to the all-time spend and never resets the daily total
unclearLabel: Starts a new day's spend at the user's local midnight
heldOutLabel: Records the spend that the side panel's daily total shows

label: Returns today's spend, or zero if the record is from another day
wrongLabel: Returns the total spend across all days
unclearLabel: Returns the spend for today in the user's time zone
heldOutLabel: Returns the number shown in the side panel's spend line

label: Groups page sections into batches capped by count and by characters
paraphrase: Splits sections into size-limited groups for fewer requests
wrongLabel: Sends each page section in its own request
unclearLabel: Batches sections to stay under the provider's prompt size limit
heldOutLabel: Groups sections so each batch finishes within the helper's timeout

label: Moves the depth preference one step simpler or deeper and records the change
paraphrase: Nudges the reading depth up or down and remembers the old value
wrongLabel: Moves the depth preference without recording what it was before
unclearLabel: Makes cards simpler after the reader presses Simpler twice
heldOutLabel: Simplifies future cards when the reader seems confused

label: Puts back the preference that was last changed for the user
paraphrase: Reverts the most recent preference change
wrongLabel: Clears every preference back to its default
unclearLabel: Undoes the change named in the card's Undo chip
heldOutLabel: Restores the preference after the reader clicks Undo in the side panel

label: Turns a git remote into an https GitHub link
paraphrase: Converts an ssh or .git remote into a web URL
wrongLabel: Clones the repository from its git remote
unclearLabel: Turns this repo's origin remote into the link used in the PR comment
heldOutLabel: Builds the GitHub link from the remote the PR was opened against
